items.description: Pipe repair materials: pipe section, sealing, rock-wool insulation
items.rationale: Escape of water from a failed supply pipe is covered. Like-for-like materials incl. sealing and insulation are repair costs under 7.1.7(c). Price level follows Case 39's itemised materials (about 150–190).

Trade labour at customary rates is covered under 7.1.7(g). This flat rate covers opening, repair and a couple of visits; Case 39 accepted far more hours, but this job is described as straightforward, so a moderate amount is taken.
One travel charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f), and this is the only one on the invoice. Prior about 81.
Drying before repair and a flat-rate equipment deployment once per drying operation are covered under 7.1.7(b),(e). Case 39 accepted at least 403; prior about 439.

items.description: Closing wall opening and painting disturbed area
items.rationale: Making good the opening is covered under 7.1.7(a), limited to the affected patch. Case 39 accepted at least 416; prior about 453.
